name: Can a garage floor coating handle heavy vehicle weight and workshop tools?

mainEntity.name: Can a garage floor coating handle heavy vehicle weight and workshop tools?

acceptedAnswer.text: Garage floor coatings are formulated to withstand typical vehicle weights, including trucks and SUVs, without crushing or peeling once fully cured. The strength comes from the underlying concrete slab; the coating provides an abrasion-resistant, chemical-proof shield over top. However, dragging heavy metal implements, dropping sharp tools, or using steel floor jacks directly on the surface without protective pads can scratch the clear topcoat. To maximize longevity, placing rubber pads under jack stands and using soft-wheeled work stools will keep the glossy finish intact during heavy automotive or workshop projects.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Fully cured coatings easily handle heavy vehicle weights, though using pads under steel floor jacks helps prevent scratching the clear topcoat.
